hook: Deleting hand-written GPU assembly made kernels better.

beats.say: glm-vx runs GLM models with GPU kernels written in Vx, which held 99 pieces of hand-written PTX across 25 files.
They moved most to MLIR ops. Fourteen of 20 pinned kernels kept every instruction, and six got fewer because the compiler could finally see around the code.
No kernel needs more registers, one spill dropped from 40 bytes to 8, and all hardware tests passed on an H200.
